recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Chicken with Vegetables
recipes.description: Bone-in chicken thighs roasted on a sheet pan with baby potatoes and broccolini, all lacquered in a bright lemon-oregano dressing. One pan, minimal cleanup, maximum crispy skin.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.notes: zested and juiced, about 3 tablespoons juice

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Whisk together olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Toss halved potatoes in the dressing, then spread them cut-side down on a rimmed sheet pan. Nestle chicken thighs skin-side up among the potatoes. Pour any remaining dressing over the chicken.
steps.tip: Skin-side up is non-negotiable — it's the only way to get properly crispy skin.

steps.text: Roast for 20 minutes, then scatter the broccolini around the chicken and potatoes. Return to oven and roast until chicken skin is golden and an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part reads 165°F, about 15 minutes more.
steps.tip: Adding broccolini later prevents it from turning to mush.

steps.text: Let rest on the pan for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes if using, and serve straight from the sheet pan.

recipes.title: One-Pot Creamy Tomato Pasta
recipes.description: Penne simmered directly in a garlicky crushed-tomato sauce, finished with cream and Parmesan. Everything cooks in a single pot — pasta included — and dinner's ready in 25 minutes.

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.notes: finely grated, plus more for serving

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, stirring until garlic is just golden, about 1 minute.
steps.tip: Watch the garlic closely — golden is great, brown is bitter.

steps.text: Add crushed tomatoes, water, oregano, and salt. Bring to a boil, then stir in the pasta. Reduce heat to a strong simmer, cover, and cook, stirring every 3 to 4 minutes to prevent sticking, until the pasta is al dente and the sauce has thickened, 14 to 16 minutes.
steps.tip: Stirring regularly is key — the starch released by the pasta is what makes the sauce creamy.

steps.text: Remove from heat. Stir in heavy cream and Parmesan until the sauce is glossy and coats the pasta. Season with more salt if needed.
Serve in bowls topped with torn basil and more Parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Savory ground chicken stir-fried with water chestnuts, ginger, and a soy-hoisin glaze, spooned into crisp butter lettuce cups. Fast, light, and deeply satisfying.

ingredients.name: green onions
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

steps.text: Stir together soy sauce, rice vinegar, hoisin, and sesame oil in a small bowl. Set aside.

Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat until just smoking. Add ground chicken and cook, breaking it into small crumbles with a wooden spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
steps.tip: Resist the urge to stir constantly — let the chicken sit and develop color before breaking it up.

steps.text: Add garlic, ginger, and the white parts of the green onions. Stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add water chestnuts and the sauce mixture, tossing to coat evenly. Cook until the liquid reduces to a glaze, about 1 minute.
Spoon the chicken mixture into lettuce cups. Top with green onion greens and a drizzle of sriracha.

recipes.title: Black Pepper Tofu
recipes.description: Crispy cubes of tofu tossed in a bold, peppery sauce with sweet onions and fresh chiles. Inspired by the Ottolenghi classic — deeply savory, a little sweet, and unapologetically spicy.

ingredients.name: dark soy sauce
ingredients.notes: or regular soy sauce plus 1 teaspoon sugar

ingredients.name: cornstarch
ingredients.notes: for coating, plus 1 teaspoon dissolved in 2 tablespoons water

steps.text: Stir together soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, black pepper, and the cornstarch slurry in a small bowl. Set aside.

Toss tofu cubes with the tablespoon of cornstarch until lightly coated. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high. Fry tofu in a single layer, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp on most sides, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
steps.tip: Don't crowd the pan — work in batches if needed. The crust depends on it.

steps.text: Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the pan. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and starting to caramelize, about 4 minutes. Add garlic and chiles, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.

Give the sauce a stir and pour it into the pan. Return the tofu and toss everything together until the sauce thickens and coats the tofu, about 1 minute. Fold in cilantro and basil off the heat. Serve immediately over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Crispy Gnocchi with Sausage and Broccoli Rabe
recipes.description: Shelf-stable gnocchi pan-fried until golden and crunchy, tossed with crumbled Italian sausage, bitter broccoli rabe, and garlic. Chewy, crispy, savory — a weeknight powerhouse.

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add sausage and cook, breaking into irregular pieces with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Transfer sausage to a plate, leaving the rendered fat in the pan.

Add the remaining tablespoon of olive oil and the butter to the skillet. Add gnocchi in a single layer and cook undisturbed until the bottoms are deeply golden and crispy, about 4 minutes. Flip and cook another 2 minutes until golden on the other side.
steps.tip: Leave the gnocchi alone — let the pan do the work. The golden crust is the whole point.

steps.text: Push the gnocchi to one side of the pan. Add garlic, red pepper flakes, and broccoli rabe to the empty side. Cook, tossing the rabe occasionally, until it wilts and turns bright green, about 3 minutes. Add a splash of water if the pan looks dry.
Return the sausage to the pan and toss everything together. Remove from heat, season with salt and pepper, and shower with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Miso-Glazed Cod
recipes.description: Thick cod fillets lacquered with a sweet-salty white miso glaze and broiled until caramelized. A simplified take on Nobu's iconic dish — elegant enough for company, easy enough for Tuesday.

steps.text: Whisk together miso, mirin, sake, sugar, and sesame oil in a small bowl until smooth.
Pat cod fillets dry with paper towels and place on a foil-lined sheet pan. Spoon the miso glaze evenly over the top and sides of each fillet.
steps.tip: For deeper flavor, marinate the fish in the glaze for up to 24 hours in the fridge — but it's excellent even without the wait.

steps.text: Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the broiler. Broil on high until the glaze is bubbling and deeply caramelized in spots, and the fish flakes easily with a fork, 8 to 10 minutes.
steps.tip: Keep an eye on it — the sugars in the miso can go from caramelized to charred fast under a broiler.

steps.text: Scatter sliced scallions and sesame seeds over the fillets. Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Skillet
recipes.description: Ground turkey, black beans, corn, and diced tomatoes simmered in a one-skillet taco filling, topped with melted cheddar. A healthier riff on taco night with zero tortilla-folding required.

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a 12-inch oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes. Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika, stirring until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add ground turkey and salt. Cook, breaking the meat into small pieces, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Stir in diced tomatoes with their juices, black beans, and corn. Bring to a simmer and cook until the liquid reduces slightly and the flavors meld, about 8 minutes.
Scatter cheddar over the top. Cover the skillet and cook until the cheese is fully melted, about 2 minutes. Top with sour cream, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Noodles
recipes.description: Chewy noodles tossed in a punchy peanut-chili sauce with crunchy toppings. Takes 15 minutes, tastes like takeout, and works hot or cold straight from the fridge the next day.

steps.text: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain, rinse under cold water, and shake off excess moisture.
steps.tip: Rinsing stops the cooking and removes surface starch so the sauce clings evenly.

steps.text: Whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, honey, chili crisp, garlic, and ginger in a large bowl. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of warm water and whisk until the sauce is smooth and pourable.
Add the noodles to the bowl and toss thoroughly until every strand is coated.
Divide among bowls. Top with cucumber, shredded carrot, chopped peanuts, cilantro, and sesame seeds. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken with Orzo
recipes.description: Seasoned chicken thighs braised with orzo, cherry tomatoes, olives, and feta in one skillet. The orzo absorbs all the pan juices as it cooks — no draining, no separate pot.

steps.text: Season chicken thighs with half the oregano, salt, and pepper. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Sear chicken until golden on both sides, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
steps.tip: The chicken doesn't need to be cooked through — it finishes while the orzo simmers.

steps.text: Reduce heat to medium. Add the remaining tablespoon of olive oil, red onion, and garlic. Cook until softened, about 2 minutes. Add orzo and remaining oregano, stirring to toast the orzo for 1 minute.

Pour in chicken broth and cherry tomatoes. Bring to a simmer, then nestle the chicken thighs back into the pan. Cover and cook until the orzo is tender and has absorbed most of the liquid, and the chicken is cooked through, 15 to 18 minutes.
Remove from heat. Stir in lemon juice and scatter olives, crumbled feta, and dill over the top.

recipes.title: Honey-Garlic Shrimp
recipes.description: Plump shrimp seared in butter and coated in a sticky honey-garlic-soy glaze with a hit of lime. From stovetop to table in under 15 minutes.

ingredients.name: large shrimp
ingredients.notes: peeled and deveined, tails on or off

steps.text: Pat shrimp dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt. Stir together honey, soy sauce, and sriracha (if using) in a small bowl.
steps.tip: Dry shrimp sear better. Wet shrimp steam — and steamed shrimp don't get that golden crust.

steps.text: Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high until the butter foams. Add shrimp in a single layer and cook without moving until the undersides turn pink and golden, about 2 minutes. Flip and cook 1 minute more.
Add garlic and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the honey-soy mixture and toss the shrimp to coat. Cook until the sauce reduces to a sticky glaze, about 1 minute.
Remove from heat, squeeze lime juice over the top, and scatter with cilantro. Serve over steamed rice.
